content:
Long before the iPod came along, the Sony Walkman was already the go-to device for those who wanted to soundtrack their lives. Now there's a Duo app that recreates that experience for those of us who once owned a Walkman — and you can use it with Apple Music…

Before the Walkman, if you wanted to listen to music on the go, your options were limited. Most cassette players at the time were heavy and bulky. Sony shrunk a recorder built for reporters down to become the smallest cassette player imaginable, and it quickly became an iconic product of its era.

Developer Vidit Bhargava created the app at a hackathon — since many people there had never seen a Walkman, he brought a real one to show them what it looked like.

You open Duo, pick your album as if you're inserting a cassette, then close the lid and playback begins.

Bhargava says he originally built it as a fun demo app, but is now actually releasing it as a proper app. The best comment in the X thread is this one — a picture that only people of a certain age will understand.

What was the first music player of your life? Share it in the comments.
